why: The door out of a blocked Library step (slice U2, 2026-09-11). It is a `<Link>` because it navigates to `/agents`, and `cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), …)` because it stands beside the Ask button that is already `<Button variant="outline" size="sm">` — the two must be one control at two tags. `control-class.ts` declares it "does not replace standard buttons", so moving this to `controlClass` would break that rule rather than honour it.
